title: Folders double as group-chat rosters — undocumented
reality: docs/characters/library-organization.md carries a dedicated section 'Folders double as group chat rosters'. A character folder is not merely an organizational bucket; it can seed a group chat's cast. references/character-cards.md mentions folders only as organization.
fix: Add to references/character-cards.md and cross-reference from the group-chat material in architecture.md. HIGH ideation value: 'organize a cast into a folder, then open it as a group chat' is a concrete workflow the skill currently cannot offer, and it changes how you would advise structuring a multi-character project.

title: 'Add persona as character' conversion undocumented
reality: docs/characters/personas.md documents an 'Add persona as character' action converting a persona into a character card. The references describe personas and characters as parallel object types (character-cards.md's 'similar fields, opposite roles' framing) without noting this bridge.
fix: Add to the persona-vs-character section of references/character-cards.md. It is the direct answer to 'I built this as a persona but now I want to chat WITH them', which the current framing implies requires manual rebuilding.

title: Library organization surface (favorites, tag chips, bulk operations) missing
reality: docs/characters/library-organization.md documents Favorites and tag chips, filtering by tags, folders, and 'Bulk select, export, and delete'. docs/characters/import-export.md documents 'Exporting many characters at once'. The `fav` and `tags` fields exist in character.schema.ts. None of these workflows appear in the references.
fix: Add a short 'Library organization' subsection to references/character-cards.md. Relevant to migration advice in particular — the skill recommends SillyTavern migration over rebuild but never explains how to manage the resulting large library.

title: Sprite background cleanup and AI sprite generation not covered
reality: docs/characters/sprites.md documents 'Generating sprites with AI', 'Cleaning up sprite backgrounds', 'Exporting sprites', and 'How sprites show up in your chat'. The references cover Sprites->Clips and the Expression Engine agent but not the sprite authoring workflow itself.
fix: Add sprite authoring to references/character-cards.md, cross-referencing the `expression` agent in agents.md. Completes a path the skill currently only covers at the consumption end (an agent picks a sprite) without the production end (how sprites get made).

title: Gallery vs chat gallery distinction undocumented
reality: docs/characters/galleries.md has a section 'How the Gallery differs from a chat's gallery' — a card-level Gallery and a chat-level gallery are distinct surfaces. The references discuss the Gallery (Images/Videos tabs, Animate, Illustrate) without drawing this boundary.
fix: Add one clarifying paragraph to references/character-cards.md or architecture.md. Prevents ambiguous click-path advice, since 'open the Gallery' currently resolves to two different places.
